result.summary: The page is generally polished, but one clear data-rendering error is visible, along with a couple of minor layout concerns related to horizontal scrolling and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card displays the invalid delivery text “€NaN delivery,” indicating a failed or missing numeric value.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery-fee data or formatting fallback so a valid amount is shown, or display a meaningful label such as “Delivery fee unavailable.”

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant and category carousels are visibly clipped at the right edge, including a partially visible category pill and truncated restaurant card/title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the clipping is intentional and provide a clear horizontal-scroll affordance, such as partial-card spacing, a carousel indicator, or accessible scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second popular restaurant card, obscuring part of its image and potentially its content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content so cards can be fully scrolled above the navigation bar.
